title: Agility Robotics Confirms $2.5B Listing and Fremont AI Hub
summary: Agility Robotics is going public through a merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI at a US$2.5 billion pre-money valuation, a deal expected to close in 2026 and to deliver over US$620 million in gross proceeds. The July 28 update reported that its Digit humanoid has logged more than 65,000 operating hours across nine customer facilities against more than US$300 million in multi-year orders. Proceeds go to fulfilling those orders and scaling Digit v5 production, alongside a new 60,000-square-foot Fremont, California AI hub for training, software and field testing that adds roughly 200 technical roles.
whyItMatters: Operating hours, not demo videos, are the metric being taken public: 65,000 hours across nine real customer sites is the first humanoid deployment record large enough to underwrite a public listing. It also puts a humanoid AI training facility next door to Tesla's Optimus line in Fremont, turning the Bay Area into a head-to-head proving ground for warehouse humanoids.
